summary: Bald Hill, Union (Tolland County), CT: 60-ft steel tower first operated 1913, site at 1,286 ft; register lists it as a tower site; no source describes what remains.

facts.status_note: Register names the place 'Bald Hill Tower Site' but gives no removal date or condition

events.note: Register says the 60-foot steel tower was first operated in 1913; construction date not given
Registered September 9, 2008, nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.quote: This 60' steel tower was first operated in 1913.

evidence.supports: register lists the place as Bald Hill Tower Site
entry sits in the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register; no removal date or condition given

notes_for_editor: Only the register page and a one-line Forest Lookouts stub were readable. The stub also says 'See: Mount Ochepitucket' (cross-reference not followed). A search snippet from the firelookout.org Connecticut listing (not fetchable here) names a Yale-run 'Walker Tower' as the successor; left out because its text could not be checked against a cached page. An earlier draft said the tower was no longer standing, resting only on the 'Tower Site' name; that claim was removed because the register records no removal. Access unknown. Story is about 125 words because the readable material is thin.
